title: Mfumo lowu makumu ya hosi ma nga vonakiki eka wona
intro: Matimu ma tive vafumi va muxaka wun’wana ni wun’wana, kambe a hi vangani lava leriseke ndhawu leyi fanaka swinene ni leyi. Laha moya hi woxe a wu hlamula xileriso xa vona ni vatirhi lava ku nga riki na tihlo leri faka leri a ri ta va vona va ri karhi va tirha hi matimba hi ku miyela, ku fuma loku a ku nga fani ni ku fuma loku a ku ri kona emahlweni kumbe endzhaku ka sweswo. Hambi swi ri tano hambi ku ri mimfumo leyikulu swinene yi fanele yi hela—naswona loko leyi yi hela, ntiyiso wu hume eka xihlovo lexi titsongahataka lerova a ku nga ri na munhu loyi a a ehleketa ku wu kanakana.
clues: Ndzi nyikiwile mfumo lowukulu hi Hosi ya mina, lowu ku vulavuriwaka ha wona ku tsemakanya matluka yo kwetsima.
Ndzi kume ndzhaka ya vutlhari lebyikulu ni vulawuri eka mutswari loyi a fambeke emahlweni ka mina hi ku tinyiketela.
Ndzi lerisile moya hi woxe, naswona wu fambe ekule hikwalaho ka swikongomelo swa mina.
Swivumbiwa leswi nga voniwiki hi mahlo lama tolovelekeke swi tirhe hi matimba ehansi ka vulawuri bya mina, swi aka swihlamariso leswi nga pimanisiwiki na nchumu.
Swihlovo swa koporo leyi n’okiweke swi ndzi khulukele, ku nga nkateko lowu hlawulekeke eka lowu hlawuriweke hi Allah.

Loko ndzi suka emisaveni leyi, miri wa mina wu sale wu yime hi nhonga. Ntsena loko xivumbiwa lexitsongo xa misava xi dya hi nhonga yoleyo, lava a va ri ekusuhi na mina va swi xiye leswaku ndzi hundzile.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
